puzzles.title: Open the Ledger
puzzles.ask: Manager: Welcome aboard! First things first, pull up the whole product ledger for me.

puzzles.title: New Price Tags
puzzles.ask: Manager: We need fresh price tags. Just the product name and price, please.

puzzles.title: Noodle Aisle Check
puzzles.ask: Manager: Let's tidy the noodle aisle. Give me the name, price, and stock of everything in Noodles.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, price, stock FROM products WHERE category = 'Noodles'

traps.name: Guessing by name
traps.sql: SELECT name, price, stock FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Ramen%'

traps.name: Hardcoded ids
traps.sql: SELECT name, price, stock FROM products WHERE id IN (1,2,3,4)

puzzles.title: Time to Reorder
puzzles.ask: Manager: Anything with 3 or fewer units left needs a reorder. Name and stock, please.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock <= 3

traps.name: Less than vs. at most
traps.sql: SELECT name, stock FROM products WHERE stock < 3

puzzles.title: Under 200 Yen
puzzles.ask: Customer: Excuse me, which drinks are 200 yen or less?
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Drinks' AND price <= 200

traps.name: Missed the boundary
traps.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Drinks' AND price < 200

puzzles.title: Snack Run
puzzles.ask: Customer: Can you show me snacks or ice cream that cost 150 yen or more? Something filling.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category IN ('Snacks', 'Ice Cream') AND price >= 150

traps.name: AND/OR precedence
traps.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Snacks' OR category = 'Ice Cream' AND price >= 150

puzzles.title: Past Expiry
puzzles.ask: Manager: Find everything that's already past its expiry date as of today (2026-03-02). Items expiring today can still be sold.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, expiry_date FROM products WHERE expiry_date < '2026-03-02'

traps.name: Included today
traps.sql: SELECT name, expiry_date FROM products WHERE expiry_date <= '2026-03-02'

puzzles.title: Expiring This Week
puzzles.ask: Manager: Anything expiring this week (March 2 to 8) gets a discount sticker.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, expiry_date FROM products WHERE expiry_date BETWEEN '2026-03-02' AND '2026-03-08'

traps.name: Excluded both ends
traps.sql: SELECT name, expiry_date FROM products WHERE expiry_date > '2026-03-02' AND expiry_date < '2026-03-08'

puzzles.title: That Banana Thing
puzzles.ask: Mrs. Sato: Oh dear, there was something with banana in it... I can't remember the name. Where is it?
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, shelf FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%Banana%'

traps.name: Matched the start only
traps.sql: SELECT name, shelf FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'Banana%'

puzzles.title: No Expiry Date
puzzles.ask: Kenji: Some items have a blank expiry date. Which ones are those?
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, category FROM products WHERE expiry_date IS NULL

traps.name: Compared with = NULL
traps.sql: SELECT name, category FROM products WHERE expiry_date = NULL

traps.name: Guessing by category
traps.sql: SELECT name, category FROM products WHERE category = 'Household'

puzzles.title: [Boss] First Disposal List
puzzles.ask: Manager: Before you clock out, make the disposal list. Anything past expiry goes, and Deli items go even if they expire today (2026-03-02). Skip anything with zero stock. Name, shelf, stock.
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, shelf, stock FROM products WHERE stock > 0 AND (expiry_date < '2026-03-02' OR (category = 'Deli' AND expiry_date = '2026-03-02'))

traps.name: Missing parentheses
traps.sql: SELECT name, shelf, stock FROM products WHERE stock > 0 AND expiry_date < '2026-03-02' OR category = 'Deli' AND expiry_date = '2026-03-02'

traps.name: Forgot the stock rule
traps.sql: SELECT name, shelf, stock FROM products WHERE expiry_date < '2026-03-02' OR (category = 'Deli' AND expiry_date = '2026-03-02')

puzzles.title: [Side] Category List
puzzles.ask: HQ: Please reply with the list of product categories your store carries.

puzzles.title: [Side] Profit per Item
puzzles.ask: Manager: I wonder how much we make per item. Show the name and margin (price minus cost).
puzzles.answer: SELECT name, price - cost AS margin FROM products

traps.name: Separate columns
traps.sql: SELECT name, price, cost FROM products
